rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 우정사업본부에 두는 보조기관ㆍ보좌기관의 직급 및 직급별 정원, 실장ㆍ단장 밑에 두는 보조기관과 이에 상당하는 보좌기관의 설치 및 사무분장 등 「우정사업본부 직제」에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Organization of Korea Post” and matters necessary for its implementation, such as the ranks and staffing levels of auxiliary and advisory bodies established within the Korea Post, the establishment and division of duties of auxiliary bodies and equivalent advisory bodies placed under the Director and Head of the Post Office.
Chapter 2 Korea Post

rows.source_ko: 제2조(우정사업본부) 우정사업본부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 임기제공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다. <개정 2013. 12. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Korea Post) The Head of Korea Post shall be appointed as a fixed-term public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A. <Amended Dec. 12, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(경영기획실장) ① 경영기획실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Head of Management Planning Office) ① The Head of the Management Planning Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: 제12조(우정사업조달센터) ① 우정사업조달센터장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2016. 5. 10., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Postal Service Procurement Center) ① The Director of the Postal Service Procurement Center shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary. <Amended May 10, 2016; August 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 우정사업조달센터에 조달총괄과ㆍ계약과ㆍ물품관리과ㆍ건축설계과ㆍ대형건축설비과ㆍ일반건축설비과 및 물류자동화과를 두되, 각 과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2015. 1. 6., 2016. 5. 10., 2021. 6. 24., 2022. 12. 30., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Postal Service Procurement Center shall have the Procurement Management Division, Contracts Division, Goods Management Division, Architectural Design Division, Large-scale Building Equipment Division, General Building Equipment Division, and Logistics Automation Division; provided that the heads of each division shall be appointed from among the Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, or Administrative Officer. <Amended Jan. 6, 2015; May 10, 2016; June 24, 2021; December 30, 2022; August 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 각 과의 사무분장 등 그 밖의 필요한 사항은 우정사업본부장이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Director of the Korea Post shall determine other necessary matters, such as the division of duties for each division.
[Title amended May 10, 2016]
Chapter 6 Subordinate Organizations of Regional Post Offices
Article 13 (Jurisdiction) The jurisdictional areas of regional post offices are as shown in Attached Table 1 .

rows.source_ko: 제14조(지방우정청) ① 서울ㆍ경인ㆍ부산ㆍ충청ㆍ전남ㆍ경북ㆍ전북ㆍ강원지방우정청장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 하고, 제주지방우정청장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Regional Postal Offices) ① The Directors of the Seoul, Gyeongin, Busan, Chungcheong, Jeonnam, Gyeongbuk, Jeonbuk, and Gangwon Regional Postal Offices shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of such positions is Grade B; and the Director of the Jeju Regional Postal Office shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, a Science and Technology Secretary, or a Secretary. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 서울 및 경인지방우정청에 우정사업국ㆍ금융사업국 및 사업지원국을 두고, 그 밖의 우정청(제주지방우정청은 제외한다)에 우정사업국 및 사업지원국을 두되, 각 국장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2015. 4. 20., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Seoul and Gyeongin Regional Postal Offices shall have a Postal Service Bureau, a Financial Service Bureau, and a Business Support Bureau, and other postal offices (excluding the Jeju Regional Postal Office) shall have a Postal Service Bureau and a Business Support Bureau; provided that each Bureau Director shall be appointed at the level of Deputy Director General, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary. <Amended Apr. 20, 2015; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제15조(우정사업국에 두는 과) ① 우정사업국에 우정계획과ㆍ우편물류과ㆍ우편영업과ㆍ예금영업과 및 보험영업과를 둔다. 다만, 서울지방우정청은 우정계획과ㆍ우편물류과ㆍ우편영업과ㆍ소포영업과 및 국제영업과를, 경인지방우정청은 우정계획과ㆍ우편물류과ㆍ우편영업과 및 소포영업과를 각각 둔다. <개정 2015. 4. 20., 2019. 7. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Divisions in the Postal Service Bureau) ① The Postal Service Bureau shall have the Postal Planning Division, the Postal Logistics Division, the Postal Business Division, the Deposit Business Division, and the Insurance Business Division. However, the Seoul Regional Postal Office shall have the Postal Planning Division, the Postal Logistics Division, the Postal Business Division, the Parcel Business Division, and the International Business Division, and the Gyeongin Regional Postal Office shall have the Postal Planning Division, the Postal Logistics Division, the Postal Business Division, and the Parcel Business Division. <Amended Apr. 20, 2015; Jul. 31, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ② 각 과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② Each Division Head shall be appointed from among Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, or Administrative Officer. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 국장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. 다만, 서울 및 경인지방우정청의 국장은 제1호부터 제7호까지 및 제11호부터 제17호까지의 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2015. 4. 20., 2020. 8. 31.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Director shall be responsible for the following matters. However, the Directors of the Seoul and Gyeongin Regional Postal Offices shall be responsible for the matters under Subparagraphs 1 through 7 and Subparagraphs 11 through 17. <Amended Apr. 20, 2015; Aug. 31, 2020>

rows.text_en: 8. Improvement and guidance on handling methods regarding postal money orders and postal transfer services

rows.text_en: Article 15-2 (Divisions in the Financial Business Bureau) ① The Financial Business Bureau shall have the Deposit Business Division, the Insurance Business Division, and the Financial Inspection Division.

rows.source_ko: ② 각 과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>

rows.text_en: 2. Improvement and guidance on handling methods regarding postal money orders and postal transfer services

rows.source_ko: 3. 우체국예금ㆍ우체국보험에 관한 취급방법의 개선 및 지도

rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning internal control of postal financial services and prevention of postal financial accidents

rows.source_ko: 제16조(사업지원국에 두는 과) ① 사업지원국에 운영지원과ㆍ인력계획과 및 회계정보과를 둔다. <개정 2014. 4. 11., 2015. 4. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Divisions in the Business Support Bureau) ① The Business Support Bureau shall have the Operations Support Division, the Human Resources Planning Division, and the Accounting Information Division. <Amended Apr. 11, 2014; Apr. 20, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ② 각 과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>

rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and coordination of various plans in preparation for national emergencies
6. Establishment, Coordination, and Evaluation of Major Business Plans
7. Duties regarding labor-management cooperation

15. Receipt, Storage, and Procurement of Goods

17. Operation and Management of Special Post Offices

rows.source_ko: 제17조(감사관) ① 지방우정청장(제주지방우정청장은 제외한다) 밑에 감사관 1명을 두되, 감사관은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Auditor) ① One Auditor shall be appointed under the Head of a Regional Postal Service (excluding the Head of the Jeju Regional Postal Service), and the Auditor shall be appointed from among the Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, Officer for Industry, Officer for Facilities, Officer for Computer Science, Officer for Broadcasting and Telecommunications, or Officer for Administration. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 감사관은 다음 사항에 관하여 청장을 보좌한다. <개정 2013. 10. 22., 2015. 4. 20.>
rows.text_en: ② The Auditor assists the Commissioner in the following matters. <Amended Oct. 22, 2013; Apr. 20, 2015>
1. Accounting and Operational Audit
2. Discipline audit of public officials
3. Internal Control of Postal Services

rows.source_ko: 제18조(제주지방우정청에 두는 과) ① 제주지방우정청에 우정사업과ㆍ사업지원과 및 감사실을 둔다.
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Divisions in the Jeju Regional Postal Service) ① The Jeju Regional Postal Service shall have a Postal Service Division, a Business Support Division, and an Audit Office.

rows.source_ko: ② 각 과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로, 감사실장은 공업주사ㆍ시설주사ㆍ전산주사ㆍ방송통신주사 또는 행정주사로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② Each Division Head shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, or Administrative Officer, and the Head of the Audit Office shall be appointed as an Industrial Assistant, Facilities Assistant, Computer Assistant, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistant, or Administrative Assistant. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

1. Opening and Closing of Post Offices and Postal Services and Management of State-Owned Property

rows.source_ko: 2. 운송선로의 개폐 및 우편구역과 집배구의 조정
rows.text_en: 2. Opening and closing of transport lines and adjustment of postal areas and delivery districts
3. Demand Survey for Postal Services

rows.source_ko: 4. 우편업무와 우편환ㆍ우편대체ㆍ우체국예금 및 우체국보험에 관한 취급방법의 개선과 지도
rows.text_en: 4. Improvement and guidance on handling methods regarding postal services, postal money orders, postal transfers, postal savings, and postal insurance
5. Management of Funds and Surplus

4. Management of Records and Operation of the Archives
5. Appointment, service, education and training, pension, and other personnel management of public officials
6. Corporate Accounting and Cost Calculation
7. Management Evaluation of Postal Service
8. Receipt, storage, and procurement of goods

rows.source_ko: 9. 국가 비상사태에 대비한 각종 계획의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 9. Establishment and coordination of various plans in preparation for national emergencies
10. Overall management of computerization, informatization, and information security for regional post offices and affiliated organizations

rows.source_ko: 11. 비정규직 인력의 종합관리 및 인력을 수반한 외부위탁 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 11. Comprehensive management of non-regular personnel and tasks related to external outsourcing involving personnel

rows.source_ko: 12. 비정규직 및 인력을 수반한 외부위탁 관련 예산편성ㆍ집행업무

14. Duties regarding labor-management cooperation

16. Management of Revenue and Expenditure

rows.text_en: 17. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other divisions within the Office

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 감사실장은 다음 사항에 관하여 청장을 보좌한다. <개정 2013. 10. 22.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Audit Office assists the Commissioner in the following matters. <Amended Oct. 22, 2013>
1. Accounting and Operational Audit
2. Discipline audit of public officials

Article 19 (Postmaster) A Postmaster shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, Administrative Officer, Industrial Clerk, Facilities Clerk, Computer Clerk, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Clerk, Administrative Clerk, Assistant Industrial Clerk, Assistant Facilities Clerk, Assistant Computer Clerk, Assistant Broadcasting and Telecommunications Clerk, or Assistant Administrative Clerk.
[Wholly Amended Aug. 30, 2023]

rows.source_ko: 제20조(우편집중국장) 우편집중국장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Director of Postal Sorting Center) The Director of a Postal Sorting Center shall be appointed from among the Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, or Administrative Officer.
[Wholly Amended Aug. 30, 2023]

rows.source_ko: 제21조(물류센터장) 물류센터장은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Director of Logistics Center) The Director of the Logistics Center shall be appointed as a Senior Secretary for Science and Technology or a Senior Secretary. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제22조(소속관서의 분장사무) ① 우체국장은 우편ㆍ우편환ㆍ우편대체ㆍ우체국예금ㆍ우체국보험 및 수탁업무에 관한 사무를 관장한다.
rows.text_en: Article 22 (Duties Distributed by Subordinate Offices) ① The Postmaster shall have jurisdiction over postal services, postal money orders, postal transfers, postal savings, postal insurance, and entrusted business.

rows.source_ko: ② 우편집중국장은 당해 우편집중국 및 관할 우체국에 접수된 우편물의 구분ㆍ발송과 관할지역에 배달되는 우편물의 구분, 3자 물류업에 관한 사무를 관장하되, 우정사업본부장이 지정하는 우편집중국장은 우편물의 수집ㆍ배달 및 중계에 관한 사무도 관장한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Director of a Postal Sorting Center shall oversee the sorting and dispatch of mail received at the relevant postal sorting center and post offices with jurisdiction, the sorting of mail delivered to the jurisdictional area, and third-party logistics business, provided that the Director of a Postal Sorting Center designated by the Director of the Korea Post shall also oversee the collection, delivery, and relay of mail.

rows.source_ko: ③ 물류센터장은 그 물류센터 및 관할 우체국에 접수되는 소포우편물(국제우편물을 포함한다)의 구분ㆍ발송과 그 물류센터에 들어오는 업체 상품의 입출고, 재고관리, 보관, 포장 등에 관한 사무를 관장한다.

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Personnel Quotas)  As for the 70 personnel exceeding the personnel quota under this Rule due to the implementation of the Organizational Structure of the Korea Post under Presidential Decree No. 24943 (5 personnel of Grade 6, 22 of Grade 7, 33 of Grade 8, and 10 of Grade 9), it shall be deemed that there are separate personnel quotas corresponding to them at the Korea Post and its affiliated organizations until the excess personnel match the personnel quota under this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(기능직 폐지에 따른 정원 조정에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행으로 기능직공무원 정원을 감축하여 증원되는 일반직공무원 정원 중 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」제26조제2항 및 제3항에 따라 통합ㆍ운영하던 정원이 있는 경우에, 그 통합ㆍ운영하던 직급에 근속승진 임용된 공무원에 대해서 해당 직급에 재직하는 동안에는 별표 2 및 별표 3의 개정규정에도 불구하고 그 정원이 우정사업본부와 그 소속기관에 있는 것으로 보고, 그에 해당하는 종전 직급의 정원은 감축된 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Adjustment of Personnel Quotas Following the Abolition of Functional Positions)  In cases where there are personnel quotas for general civil servants that are increased by reducing the personnel quota for functional civil servants due to the enforcement of this Rule, and where such quotas were integrated and operated pursuant to Article 26, Paragraphs 2 and 3 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies,” for civil servants appointed by promotion based on seniority to the integrated and operated ranks, such quotas shall be deemed to exist within the Korea Post and its affiliated agencies during their tenure in the relevant ranks, notwithstanding the amended provisions of Annex 2 and Annex 3, and the personnel quota for the corresponding former ranks shall be deemed to have been reduced.

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Organizations Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The Safety and Health Team and the Insurance Product Development Team established under the enforcement of this Rule pursuant to Article 29 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies” shall each remain in existence until June 30, 2029.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 안전보건팀장 및 보험상품개발팀장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 같은 항에 따른 존속기한의 다음 날부터 안전보건팀장이 분장하는 사항은 노사협력담당관이, 보험상품개발팀장이 분장하는 사항은 보험개발심사과장이 각각 수행한다.
rows.text_en: ② If no special provisions are established regarding the matters assigned to the Head of the Safety and Health Team and the Head of the Insurance Product Development Team until the expiration date under Paragraph 1, from the day following the expiration date under the same paragraph, the matters assigned to the Head of the Safety and Health Team shall be performed by the Labor-Management Cooperation Officer, and the matters assigned to the Head of the Insurance Product Development Team shall be performed by the Head of the Insurance Development Review Division, respectively.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(총액인건비제로 조정한 직급의 존속기한) 이 규칙 시행으로 조정되는 별표 3의 정원 78명(우정주사보 32명, 우정서기보 46명)은 2028년 6월 30일까지 존속하며, 2028년 7월 1일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 별표 3의 정원 78명(우정서기 78명)으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Duration of Positions Adjusted to the Total Personnel Cost System) The authorized  quota of 78 personnel (32 Postal Assistants and 46 Postal Assistant Clerks) set forth in Annex 3, which is adjusted by the enforcement of this Rule, shall remain in effect until June 30, 2028, and thereafter shall be deemed to be the corresponding authorized quota of 78 personnel (78 Postal Clerks) set forth in Annex 3.
